Trace, implement and test: leetcode318 maximum product of word lengths bit operation1 with cache

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<string>
#include<unordered_map>
#include<unordered_set>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int maxProduct(vector<string>& words) {
        const int len = words.size();
        vector<int> lens(len);     // cache lengths
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
            lens[i] = words[i].size();

        int res = 0;
        vector<int> hash(len);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            for (auto& ch : words[i])           
                hash[i] |= 1 << (ch - 'a');
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
            {
                if ((hash[i] & hash[j]) == 0)
                    res = max(res, lens[i] * lens[j]);                
            }
        }   
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<string> s = {"abcw", "baz", "foo", "bar", "xtfn", "abcdef", "foo"};
    auto res = sol.maxProduct(s);
    // 预期输出结果为: 16
    cout << res << endl;
        
    return 0;
}
